signal: Surgical Information Systems debuted its AI-powered SIS Scribe at ASCA 2026 and was named 2026 Best in KLAS for ambulatory surgery center solutions.

email.body1:
Craig, saw SIS debut AI-powered SIS Scribe at ASCA 2026 and take the Best in KLAS spot for ASC solutions.

A launch plus that recognition usually means more in-market surgical facilities in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for SIS off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Craig, quick follow-up for SIS.

A product win expands the facilities worth chasing faster than headcount can ramp, so accounts go untouched and the quarter quietly leaks pipeline. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Craig, last bit of proof for SIS.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how SIS reply rate likely compares to other healthcare-software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Craig, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a launch cycle is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I will tailor it to SIS either way.
